task.description: Implement ISS-0132 (GH #427): add checkAllAllocationFailures coverage for parseGraphJson, prove it fails on unfixed code, fix the leaks it exposes, wire the tests into `zig build test`.
acceptance_criteria: allocation-failure tests exist for cloneJsonValueSafe/cloneObjectMapSafe, parseTimerConfig, parseGraphJson
tests demonstrably FAIL on unfixed code and PASS after the fix
zig build test exits 0 with no DebugAllocator leak output
tests wired into zig build test so coverage cannot silently lapse
every alloc site reached by the harnesses has a matching errdefer

result.summary: Added TC-ISS-0132-04/05 (parseGraphJson) via std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures. PROVEN to reproduce leaks on main's exact parseGraphJson (git diff showed 0 deleted lines at the time): '1 pass, 2 fail (3 total); 2 leaks', TC-04 fail_index 6/25 allocated 1713 / freed 1711 at store.zig:1344 (.label dupe), TC-05 fail_index 9/11 allocated 1807 / freed 1805 at store.zig:1366 (.source dupe). Fixed PGJ-1 (errdefer+bare deinit -> single defer), PGJ-2 and PGJ-3 (per-field guarded locals so each successful dupe is owned before the next fallible one runs). Tests now 3/3 pass. Added src/definition_store_test_root.zig refAllDecls shim and wired run_definition_store_tests into the aggregate test_step; tools/lint_test_wiring.py caught that a narrow step alone was insufficient (ISS-0150 class) and now PASSes.
